title: Trace a tiny causal Transformer from pretraining to instruction-style adaptation
hardware: CPU-only tiny Transformer pilot; physical accelerator execution is not tested

stages.title: Causal next-token pretraining
stages.evidence: Independent causal mask, shifted target and token-normalized CE checks; train-only tokenizer; chapter-held-out validation; source/config/model/tokenizer-bound base checkpoint.
stages.expected: PASS causal-lineage stage 1: causal checks, next-token pretraining, and held-out validation receipt
stages.diagnosis: Inspect query/key mask orientation, PAD-key exclusion, one-token shift and the valid-target denominator before changing model capacity.
stages.codeGuide: Implement causal_attention_mask, shift_tokens, masked_causal_cross_entropy, and sample_next_token in projects/causal-lineage/my_model.py. The independent verifier checks NumPy loss, target alignment, future-token invariance and an empty target mask.

stages.title: Instruction-style continuation, held-out perplexity and export
stages.evidence: Requires the exact stage-1 predecessor; adapts only response targets from train chapters; compares pretrained/adapted next-token perplexity with a unigram baseline on identical validation/test tokens; checks parent tampering and fresh-process export sampling.
stages.expected: PASS causal-lineage all: independent causal checks, real-data stages, checkpoint predecessor rejection, held-out unigram comparison, and fresh-process export sampling
stages.diagnosis: Verify that only continuation response tokens contribute to adaptation loss and that the stage-2 manifest names the actual stage-1 checkpoint hash.
stages.codeGuide: Use the same output directory from stage 1. Inspect the train-only adaptation labels, exact checkpoint predecessor, target counts, baseline comparison, source hashes and exported sample; the narrow passage-continuation exercise does not establish general instruction following.

rubric: Causal attention excludes all future keys and padding keys, with a perturbation test on the real decoder.
Shifted next-token targets and token-normalized cross-entropy agree with an independent NumPy oracle.
Tokenizer and adaptation examples use only training chapters; chapter groups remain isolated.
Adaptation is a response-masked next-token objective with source continuation text, not preference optimization or RLHF.
Stage 2 inherits and validates the actual pretraining checkpoint, and rejects a substituted parent.
Held-out pretraining and adapted perplexity are compared against a unigram baseline on identical tokens.
A fresh process reloads verified export bytes and performs seeded next-token sampling.
The result is labeled a small CPU pilot and is kept distinct from the planned approximately-300M capstone.
setupNote: Use the extracted workspace root and requirements-research.txt with Python >=3.11,<3.15. The checker defaults to the starter, which raises until implemented. Reuse one output directory for stages 1 then 2; no runtime data download, hosted service, upload or accelerator is required.

setupCommands.unix:
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements-research.txt
